tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// snyi mo sgom chen gyi dris lan bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas/ dad pa dang 'dun pa dang ldan zhing sgrub pa snying por byed pa snyi mo sgom chen la spring ba/ khyed kyi dri ba dang po tshe 'di blos gtang ba'i rgyu gang yin zer ba la/ 'khor ba snying po med par shes pa yin/ gnyis pa rkyen ni 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs mthong ba yin/ gsum pa blos thong ba'i tshad ni/ 'jig rten chos brgyad la blo log pa yin/ bzhi pa rtags ni 'jig rten chos brgyad bsgos kyang mi 'gos pa yin/ lnga pa tshe gcig gis 'tshang rgya ba'i tshad ni/ lus 'di nyid rga shi las grol nas/ sku bzhi'i ngo bo grub pa yin gsungs/ drug pa lung du ma bstan pa'i las ni/ 'bras bu bzang ngan gang yang 'byin mi nus pa'i las yin/ bdun pa bsngo ba ni/ rgyu dge ba'i rtsa ba 'bras bu gang du 'dod pa sgyur bar byed pa yin/ brgyad pa smon lam ni/ 'bras bu gya nom pa la smon pa yin/ dgu pa bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i don ni/ bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ 'bras bu bzang po bskyed pa'i tshig khyad par can yin/ bcu pa sems rtogs pa la/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi/ brtsir btub bam mi btub zer ba la/ sems stong par rtog pa dang*/ snang stong zung 'jug tu rtogs pa gnyis yod/ stong par rtogs pa la/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i don brtsir mi btub/ gal te btub na/ nyan thos kyi 'gog pa la'ang brtsir btub par 'gyur ba las/ 'gog pa ste stong pa rkyang pa'i mthar lhung bas theg pa chen po'i brjod bya'i don brtsir mi btub par/ theg pa chen po'i mdo rgyud thams cad las 'byung ba yin/ zung 'jug tu rtogs pa la brtsi na nyes byas phra ba'i phra bas ma gos pa/ tshul khrims kyi gzhi 'dul ba'i sde snod/ dpa' bar 'gro ba la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin thams cad de las 'byung bas mdo sde'i sde snod/

gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi shes bya thams cad shes pas mngon pa'i sde snod/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel khyad par can rnams rtogs pa'i sgo nas rgyud sde bzhi tshang ba yin/ bcu gcig pa/ rang sems kyi steng du dkon mchog gsum tshang ngam zer ba la/ sems stong pa'i cha rkyang pa dang*/ stong pa ngo 'phrod pa'i cha la/ dkon mchog gsum tshang du mi btub/ sems rig stong zung 'jug la/ dkon mchog gsum gyi sa bon tshang zhing*/ zung 'jug gi don legs par rtogs na mngon 'gyur du tshang ba yin/ bcu gnyis pa/ mchog gi dngos grub bla ma dang*/ yi dam dang gang las thob zer ba la/ de gnyis so sor phye ba las mi 'byung*/ bla ma dang yi dam dang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang*/ rang gi sems dang*/ 'khor 'das thams cad dbyer med du rtogs pa las 'byung ba yin/ bcu gsum pa/ bla ma mtshan nyid par gang gis 'gro zer ba la/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i dbang bzhi phyin ci ma log pa thob pa'i yul cig bla ma mtshan nyid par 'gyur/ dbang bskur ma thob pa'i bla ma ji ltar gang zag bzang yang bla ma btags pa ba yin/ dper na rab tu byung nas mkhan po mtshan nyid pa yod pa la rab tu ma byung ba la mkhan po mtshan nyid pa med cing*/ mkhan po zhes brjod kyang btags pa ba yin/ des na/ dbang ma bskur la bla ma med// rab byung min la mkhan po med// sdom pa med la dge rgyun med// skyabs 'gro med la chos pa min// zhes brjod pa'i don yang de lags/ bcu bzhi pa/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung gcig la thos bsam bsgom gsum tshang ba srid dam zer ba la/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung gcig la brten nas/ thos bsam bsgom gsum tshang bar byar btub/ gsung gi ngo bo de/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung gi phrin las bya ba yin/ bco lnga pa/ sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i chos thams cad gang zab zer ba la/ gdul bya so so so so'i bsam pa'i ngo bo la ltos nas/

thams cad kyang zab pa yin/ thun mong du gzhan gsang sngags kho na zab pa yin/ bcu drug pa sems stong par rtogs pa la sangs rgyas 'byung ngam mi 'byung zer ba la/ stong pa rkyang pa rtogs pa las sangs rgyas mi 'byung*/ shes bya thams cad rtogs na 'tshang rgya ba yin/ de la'ang rtogs lugs gnyis yod/ don dam pa rtogs rgyu med par rtogs pa dang*/ kun rdzob tu ci snyed yod pa de snyed so sor rtogs pa yin/ bcu bdun pa/ khyod rtogs ldan du zhal gyis bzhes sam mi bzhes zer ba la/ ngas don dam par chos gang yang rtogs rgyu ma rnyed pas/ rtogs ldan du khas mi len/ tha snyad kun rdzob tu shes bya rig pa'i gnas lnga shes pas mkhas par khas 'che ba yin/ bco brgyad pa/ khyed kyi gra pa na sems ngo 'phrod pa yod dam zer ba la/ nged kyi gra pa 'di na'ang don dam par sems rtogs rgyu med par go la/ tha snyad kun rdzob tu shes bya la mkhas pa mang po gda'/ sems la ngo bo med par sems ngo shes par cang mchi 'am/ bcu dgu pa sems ngo ma 'phrod na/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags kyang gnas skabs kyi bde bar mi 'gyur ram zer ba la/ sems kyi gnas lugs stong pa nyid kyi don ma rtogs na bsod nams kyi tshogs kyis rnam grol gyi bde ba thob mi nus par/ srid pa'i rtse mo man chad kyi bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba lags mod/ bsod nams kyi tshogs ma rdzogs shing*/ shes bya mi shes na sems stong par rtogs pa rkyang pa la'ang sangs rgyas cang mchi 'am/ stong par rtogs pa rkyang pa nyan thos kyi 'gog pa la'ang yod/ nam mkha' stong par yang yod de/ de dag la sangs rgyas ji ltar mchi/ des na shes bya thams cad la mkhas shing*/ rang gis ngo bo rtogs rgyu med par rtogs/ mkhas rgyu med par mkhas pa la sangs rgyas 'byung ba mdo rgyud thams cad kyi dgongs pa yin/ nyi shu pa/ bla ma pa dus ji tsam na sangs rgyas pa'i nges pa mchis sam zer ba la/

gang zag la las sems rkyang pa stong par rtogs kyang*/ thabs kyi yon tan ma rdzogs/ la la yon tan yod kyang sems stong par ma rtogs/ la la gnyis ka yod kyang*/ thabs mkhas pas 'phen mi nus/ kha cig la gzhan yod kyang*/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa med pas gsal snang bskyed ma nus/ des na de dag la sangs rgyas 'gyang gis dogs/ nged la 'di rnams ci rigs tshang bas/ myur du 'tshang rgya rgyu med pa'i tshul gyis 'tshang rgya ba re ba lags/ nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ khyed kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma gang yin zer ba la/ nged kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa drug pa rdo rje 'chang dpal sa skya pa chen po de lags/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i bla mar bgyid pa'i rgyu mtshan gang lags zer ba la/ bum dbang la sogs pa'i dbang bzhi bskur/ bskyed rim la sogs pa'i lam bzhi bstan/ sprul sku la sogs pa'i sku bzhi'i rten 'brel 'grig mdor na sangs rgyas kyi mdo rgyud nas ji ltar gsungs pa ltar mdzad par gda' bas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mdzad pa po lags pas rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin pa lags/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa bzhin dbang ma bskur/ lam ma bstan/ rten 'brel ma bsgrigs pa sems ngo sprod pa des bsod nams ci rigs pa bsags kyang nyan thos kyi 'gog pa'i gdams ngag tu 'dug pas/ de 'dra'i rigs can theg pa chen po'i gang zag gi rtsa ba'i bla mar gzung du mi rung ba yin te/ lam de theg pa chen po'i lam ma yin pa'i phyir ro// de yang sdud pa las/ thabs med shes rab bral bas nyan thos nyid du ltung*// zhes bya ba dang*/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ thabs dang mi ldan ye shes dang*// bslab pa dag kyang gsungs pa ni// dpa' bo chen pos nyan thos rnams// de la gzhug pa'i phyir gsungs so// des na thabs gtso chung*/ shes rab gtso che ba rnams nyan thos kyi 'gog par ltung ba yin/

nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ mkhas pa paṇḍi ta dang*/ ku su lu gnyis sangs rgyas la lam thag gang nye zer ba la/ spyir ku su lu bya ba de ma dag pa yin/ ku sa li zhes pa dge ba can zhes bya ba yin/ de la sangs rgyas kyi lam la ma brten pa'i ku sa li yang yod/ sangs rgyas kyi lam la ma brten pa'i paṇḍi ta yang yod/ de gnyis ka la sangs rgyas mi mchi/ sangs rgyas pa'i paṇḍi ta dang*/ sangs rgyas pa'i ku sa li gnyis gnyis yod de/ de la pha rol tu phyin pa'i paṇḍi ta dang*/ ku sa li gnyis ka la sangs rgyas 'ong ste/ bskal pa grangs med gsum la sogs pa yun ring du 'gor/ gsang sngags pa'i paṇḍi ta dang*/ ku sa li gnyis po de/ rten 'brel nang du bsgrigs pas myur du 'tshang rgya ba yin/ de'ang paṇḍi ta bya ba phyi nang gi shes bya'i gnas la mkhas pa la zer/ ku sa li zhes bya ba phyi'i spros pa thams cad bcad nas/ nang la mchog tu gzhol ba la zer/ mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba la dang po shes bya thams cad la mkhas par byas nas thos bsam gyi sgo nas sgro 'dogs bcad/ de nas ting nge 'dzin snying por byed pas bsgom pa'i sgo nas sgro 'dogs bcad pas rtogs pa'i chos mngon du 'gyur nas rim gyis 'tshang rgya ba yin pas paṇḍi ta dang*/ ku sa li'i gzhi mthun cig dgos pa yin/ ya gyal gyi dbang du byas na/ mkhas pas sangs rgyas la nye ba yin/ 'o na dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ gang gis bskal ba bcu bar du// mnyan te gzhan la bshad pa bas// gang zhig skad cig gcig bsgoms na// de yi bsod nams de bas lhag /ces gsungs pa dang mi 'gal lam snyam na/ de'i dgongs pa ni/ thog mar bsgom bya'i don mkhas pa shes na bsgom pa la dgongs pa yin gyis mi shes par bsgom pa la phan yon de lta bu ga la 'byung*/ 'dul ba las kyang*/ sde snod 'dzin pa ma yin pa ri khrod du mi bsgom par bshad/ mngon pa mdzod las kyang*/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pa// bsgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor// zhes gsungs pa dang*/

slob dpon 'phags pas kyang*/ tha snyad la ni ma brten par// dam pa'i don ni rtogs mi 'gyur// dam pa'i don ni ma rtogs par// mya ngan 'das pa thob mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// des na mdo thams cad nas rnam grangs 'di thos pas/ 'di nyid grol zhes mang du gsungs pas/ thos pas ma grol na phyis bsgom par gsungs pa'o// khyod kyang rtogs ldan du bzhugs pa ngo mtshar che/ da dung gsang sngags kyi thabs lam la 'bad na legs snyam/ rtogs ldan khyod kyis dris pa'i lan// rtogs rgyu med par bdag gis rtogs// go rgyu med par bdag gis go /shes bya med par bdag gis shes// snyi mo sgom chen gyis dris pa'i lan du btab pa/ re zhig rdzogs so// //'di'i phyi mo dag pa ma rnyed cing*// dris lan gzhung dang de bzhin gzhan da gis// mchan du btab pa'ang rnam par 'dres gyur pa// dag par bgyi dang rnam par phyed bgyi'i phyir// gsungs pa po de'i zhabs rdul gus len pa// 'phags pa zhes byas byi dor cung zad bgyis// 'di la nongs gang de la bzod par rigs// dge bas 'gro blo rnam par dag gyur cig// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
